예약 제출·오류 메시지·확인 후 수정·저장 복원을 구현했습니다. 7–8명으로 변경할 때 17:00 선택을 지우고 이유를 표시하며, 제출 시에도 인원·시간 조건을 검사합니다.

The external harness runs node build.mjs and browser acceptance; provide buildable React source. Do not request extra shell permissions or claim an external build was already run. Work only in this starter. Report files and limitations when finished.
This task has a staged requirement change. First implement real working date/time/guest controls in buildable source. STOP this turn at that checkpoint, report the source files, and await the next instruction before implementing the rest. The external harness must independently build and exercise the controls before sending the next instruction. Do not invent the later change.
